examples: Keep notes docked beside the terminal on a wide screen instead of floating over it.
how_to: Open files or notes from their keys on the right widget bar (or the terminal cell's three-dot menu); the drawer docks beside the terminal, which shrinks to fit.
Opening the other one swaps it into the same slot.
The notes drawer's header is the standard widget header: right-click it, or press Shift+F10 on its top left icon, for the notes actions, open as widget and close.

media.alt: A terminal shrunk to fit beside a docked notes drawer
media.caption: The notes drawer docked on the right

name: Right drawer docking
summary: the file drawer and notes drawer share one slot on the right edge that docks beside the page or overlays it, depending on room.
where: The right edge of a session: the files and notes drawers open there.
